summary: Frontend-only testing of SHISFEST'26 Events feature (Events grid, EventCard, EventModal, Home EventsPreview). All 26 events verified present in data with correct category distribution. Modal opens with full content (no truncation), Hindi content renders exactly (Devanagari, correct headings), category filters work, all 3 dismiss methods (Escape, click-outside overlay, close button) work correctly, no route change on modal open, incomplete-data events (Dress Design, Ad-Lingo) render gracefully with informative note instead of breaking, no phone numbers/emails leaked anywhere, mobile responsiveness (375px) verified working (single-column grid, wrapping chips, scrollable/closable modal). Home page 'The line-up' preview correctly shows 3 featured cards (Slam Poetry, Tamasha, BioFlix), modal opens from there too, and 'View all events' link navigates to /events correctly. No console errors observed during testing.
critical_code_review_comments: events.ts (1122 lines) exceeds the 700-line file-size guideline, but since it is purely static structured data (not logic), splitting is optional and low priority.
EventCard.tsx summary text truncation (getSummary) only affects the short card preview snippet, not the modal — correctly follows the 'no truncation in modal' rule.
No sensitive contact info (phone/email) present in the events.ts data model at all, so the 'no phone/email in modal' requirement is inherently satisfied by design.
Radix Dialog correctly handles Escape/click-outside natively; no manual event listener bugs found.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None - static data file already contains all 26 events
